# GitHub Copilot instructions for certification-ai-103

This repository contains study notes for the Microsoft AI-103 certification. Keep the work focused on certification content, Azure AI services, service relationships, and clear study notes.

## Active instruction files

- `.github/instructions/agent-behaviour.instructions.md` - collaboration, safety, and scope rules for agents.
- `.github/instructions/documentation.instructions.md` - documentation writing guidance.
- `.github/instructions/markdown.instructions.md` - Markdown formatting rules.
- `.github/instructions/documentation-maintainability.instructions.md` - file size, topic boundaries, and reviewability rules for documentation.
- `.github/instructions/certification-content.instructions.md` - AI-103 content authoring rules.

## Read first

- `README.md` - repository purpose and folder structure.
- `docs/progress.md` - current state and next work.
- `docs/glossary.md` - shared terms for Azure AI and certification notes.

## Scope

This repo is documentation-first. Do not add code samples, generated apps, infrastructure, automation, continuous integration workflows, or deployment files unless the user explicitly asks for that work.

Use the other workspace repository only as a source for Copilot customization patterns. Do not copy its product content, .NET guidance, Model Context Protocol details, Azure Pipelines documentation, build rules, test rules, packaging rules, or solution-file conventions into this repo.

## Content standards

Summarize certification content in original words. Do not copy Microsoft Learn passages into this repository. Brief descriptions of Azure services are allowed when they are original, accurate, and linked to official Microsoft documentation.

Prefer concise notes, tables, diagrams, and comparisons that help with study and recall. Keep module notes separate from Azure service reference pages when the same service appears in multiple modules.
